subject.title: [Bug] Feishu: message(action=send) renders card JSON as plain text instead of interactive card (regression)

question: Should the next Feishu plain-message card JSON fix require live Feishu proof before adoption, or may maintainers accept a narrow source-and-test proof path?
rationale: The source bug is clear, but three direct parser PRs closed unmerged and current labels ask for maintainer review before another automated fix branch, so proof sufficiency needs a human Feishu-owner decision.

options.title: Require live Feishu proof first
options.body: Keep the issue open and wait for a candidate branch or maintainer run that proves `message(action=send)` renders the interactive card in a real Feishu chat before adoption.

options.title: Accept source/test proof
options.body: Allow a narrow Feishu-plugin parser fix with focused tests and treat live Feishu proof as desirable but not required for this regression.

options.title: Retire raw JSON auto-detection
options.body: Decide that plain `message` card JSON is no longer a supported send shape and update docs to direct users to structured card or presentation payloads.

recommendation.title: Require live Feishu proof first
recommendation.body: Keep the issue open and wait for a candidate branch or maintainer run that proves `message(action=send)` renders the interactive card in a real Feishu chat before adoption.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the documented Feishu plugin owner and best placed to set the Feishu-specific proof bar.
